text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to understand and interpret visual information from the world. Two key tasks in computer vision are image recognition and object detection. Image recognition allows a computer to identify what an image contains, such as a cat or a tree. Object detection goes further by locating and labelling multiple objects within a single image. These technologies have many useful applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle recognise traffic signs, pedestrians, and other cars on the road. This allows the car to make safe driving decisions. From security cameras to medical imaging, computer vision is changing how machines interact with the world around them.
